enquiry.title: Enquiries
enquiry.description: People who have asked your chamber to take work, and a conflict check before you decide.
enquiry.gatedNotice: Enquiries are kept as your own record. Nothing is sent to the enquirer from here: no reply, no template, no automatic message.
enquiry.offline: You are offline. The enquiry log is read-only until you are back online.

empty.title: No enquiries yet
empty.body: Log an enquiry when someone asks you to take work, then check it against your matters.

conflict.title: Conflict check
conflict.notRun: The conflict check has not been run.
conflict.count: {count, plural, =0 {No matches found} one {# match found} other {# matches found}}
conflict.warning: Possible conflict. Review before you proceed.
conflict.noHits: No matches found in your matters. This is not a clearance: the decision is yours.

role.adverse: Against your client on that matter

note.label: Decision note
note.hint: For your own thinking. It is not saved.

error.required: Add the enquirer's name and a summary.
error.forbidden: You cannot do this in this workspace.
error.invalid: Check the details and try again.
error.conflict: This enquiry has changed. Refresh and try again.

outcome.title: Close enquiry
outcome.hint: Optional. Nothing is sent to the enquirer.
